title: Qwen-VL Batch Captioner
description: Batch-caption images for LoRA / diffusion datasets with official Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (bf16). Send a zip or a single image_url; get kohya-style sidecar .txt files plus captions.json. Optional short VQA. Headless Transformers + official chat template — no Gradio, not a general vLLM chat endpoint, and not a JoyCaption listing.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

input.name: Model id
input.description: Hugging Face model id. Default is Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (Apache-2.0, public, no token). 2B and 8B Instruct are optional; 8B is tight on 24 GB. Weights are cached on a network volume when one is attached; they are not baked into the image.

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Pinned weights revision (do not switch to a floating main). Default is the 4B Instruct pin.

input.name: Mode
input.description: caption (default) writes a sidecar .txt for each image. vqa answers a single question (set QUESTION). This is not a general chat endpoint.

input.name: Language
input.description: Caption language. en (default) and zh are first-class. Other codes add an explicit 'Write the caption in …' instruction.

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz of images. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url). Sidecar .txt files are written next to each image.

input.name: Default single image URL
input.description: https URL of one image. Use instead of, or together with, a dataset zip. Usually sent per job (input.image_url).

input.name: Max new tokens
input.description: Maximum caption length in tokens. Defaults: 128 short / 256 medium / 512 long.

input.name: Greedy decoding
input.description: Use greedy decoding instead of sampling (T=0.7, top-p=0.8, top-k=20). Convenient for smoke tests.

input.name: Preset
input.description: Named defaults. 'default' is caption medium English. 'quick' is greedy with 128 tokens. 'chinese' is caption medium zh.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the captions zip + captions.json. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token with write access, only needed for HF_OUTPUT_REPO. Qwen3-VL Instruct weights are public Apache-2.0 and do not need a token. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Never put the token in the job input.

input.name: Caption watchdog (s)
input.description: Advisory timeout in seconds (0 = off). Keep below the endpoint execution timeout. A cold start may download ~8.27 GiB of public 4B weights if no volume cache is attached.
